title: RSI
summary: RSI scores recent up moves against recent down moves on a 0 to 100 scale. High readings mean recent up moves were bigger, not that a fall is due.
unreliableWhen: In strong trends, RSI can stay above 70 or below 30 for many candles while price keeps going. Divergence can last a long time.
goodExample: Reading RSI 75 as "up moves have been about three times the down moves lately".
badExample: Selling because RSI is above 70 during a strong uptrend.

chart.lookFor: Find a stretch where RSI 14 stays above 70 while price keeps rising, and count the candles. Then try Crash for the same below 30.
